summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 (E2E Test Expansion & Staging Baselines) covering account cleanup helpers, media/streaming tests, batch download tests, and capturing staging performance baselines including BYO-IPFS load tests with Pinata.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (13/13 must-haves passed). Staging baselines captured (journey timing, 200-client sustained load). PR #392 created with additional workflow improvements for configurable BYO load testing from GitHub Actions.

repo: Staging Web3Auth (Core Kit) initialization takes ~22.7s — wallet button timeout in E2E tests must exceed this; vault load after auth is only 142ms
Playwright config BASE_URL env var was not being respected — required explicit `process.env.BASE_URL || 'http://localhost:5173'` in playwright.config.ts and conditional webServer block
The cleanup helper deleteAccountViaPage derives API URL from the current page URL (app.cipherbox.cc → api.cipherbox.cc) because VITE_API_URL is not accessible from Playwright test context

SDK load tests in tests/load/ use destroyClientPool() for account cleanup (direct API calls, no browser); browser E2E load tests use deleteAccountViaPage (requires Playwright page context) — these are distinct paths
Vitest does not auto-load .env files — must source the .env manually before running vitest, e.g. `set -a && source .env && set +a && vitest run`

Running two SDK load test suites simultaneously against staging saturates the API even with throttle bypass — the 429 errors in the initial load tests were caused by concurrent test runs, not a bypass header bug
THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET works correctly when verified in isolation; the staging throttle guard is at NestJS level, not Caddy
Pinata free tier quota exhausts quickly under load testing — BYO capacity ceiling test consumed all available pins; paid plan needed for real BYO pin baselines

BYO register-cid and ipns-publish return 400 on staging when called from SDK load tests — pin to Pinata succeeds but CipherBox API rejects CID registration, likely test account not configured for BYO mode
The browser-based load test (load-test.spec.ts) measures Playwright/Chromium overhead not API performance — removed in favor of SDK harness which drives 200 headless clients with real API metrics

code.finding: deleteAccountViaPage uses page.evaluate to fire fetch calls with credentials:include for cookie-based auth; derives API base URL from page.url() hostname substitution (app. → api.)
Added BASE_URL env var support with conditional webServer block — when BASE_URL is set, webServer is skipped and baseURL points to remote; without it, local dev server starts on port 5173
Wallet button visibility timeout increased from 20s to 45s to accommodate Web3Auth staging init time (~22.7s)
Steps through 50→100→200→500→1000 clients to find BYO contention ceiling; uses vitest with manual .env sourcing

BYO scenarios added to scenario dropdown; BYO config (endpoint, protocol, label) as workflow_dispatch inputs with defaults so different providers can be compared per-run; only auth token remains as secret (LOAD_TEST_BYO_AUTH_TOKEN); BYO env vars scoped to byo-* scenarios only

workflow: Cherry-picking from worktree branches to phase branch requires careful STATE.md conflict resolution — worktree agents update STATE independently and conflicts are common
classifyHandoffIfNeeded errors in Claude Code are runtime bugs not GSD failures — spot-check SUMMARY.md existence and git commits to verify actual completion
Running parallel load tests against the same staging instance invalidates results — always run load tests sequentially and solo against staging
GSD worktrees can leave git index locks (.git/index.lock) that block subsequent worktrees — clean with `git worktree prune` and manual lock removal before retrying
Phase verification should happen after all checkpoint tasks complete including human-action items; marking phase complete prematurely requires reverting roadmap/state commits
When a load test 'fails' due to threshold violations (p95 latency) but ops completed with low error rate, the data is still valid baseline — exit code 1 doesn't mean unusable results

friction: Cherry-picking commits from multiple worktrees to phase branch caused repeated STATE.md merge conflicts requiring manual resolution
Stale worktrees left git index locks that blocked the 34-03 agent on first attempt — required force cleanup before retry
Running two load tests simultaneously invalidated initial results, requiring re-investigation and re-runs
SSH to staging VPS failed (timeout/key issue) during throttle bypass diagnostics — had to use curl-based verification instead
Phase was prematurely marked complete in ROADMAP.md before meaningful load test baselines were captured — required reverting the completion commit
Pinata free tier exhausted during BYO capacity ceiling test, making all byo-pin operations fail 100% — required account cleanup before any valid BYO data could be captured
Vitest doesn't load .env files by default — the attempted fix via vitest config loadEnv (Vite export, not vitest) failed; workaround was shell env sourcing
The 1Password git signing was unavailable during commit, causing a commit to fail and require retry with different approach
34-04 partial SUMMARY.md from checkpoint needed manual finalization after the human-action checkpoint workflow completed
